lines.text: A person sits still on the floor, upright and quiet, holding a frozen seated pose with almost no movement.
Still seated on the floor, the person gently rocks their body and makes small attempts to stretch the arms and legs without leaving the pose.
The person stays low on the floor and begins to move little by little, using small shifts of weight and gentle limb movements to initiate change.
While staying in the same seated pose, the person slowly shifts across the floor from the original spot toward a new position.
The person arrives at a new position and becomes still again, holding the same seated pose as in the beginning.
